title: Manganese for Hair: Benefits, Food Sources & How Much You Need
seo_title: Manganese Benefits for Hair: What It Does & Best Sources | FullyVital
seo_description: How manganese supports the antioxidant and energy enzymes your hair follicles rely on, the best food sources, how much you need and when more is too much.
notes: Citation style v2 (your rule): 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links. Dropped Saxena, Barceloux, Freeland-Graves and Filippini. Removed the oxidative-stress-and-graying line, the whole-grain 8 to 9 mg history, the 'absorption is limited' detail and the 'nutrients that work alongside' section.
Kept the positive angle: manganese's real role in MnSOD and energy enzymes, tied to oxidative stress research on hair.
Removed unsupported claims that manganese directly promotes hair growth or prevents hair loss; the article now says direct hair studies haven't been done.
Food sources and intake figures now come from three studies, including the 1.8-2.3 mg/day adequate intake.
Added a safety section on manganese overexposure and the Key Takeaways and FAQ blocks.
